candidate: Compute/store one FC2 Y vector per exact complete source class; use occurrence counts for current-domain BN moments; scatter normalized class value and add each original real shortcut separately.
scope: Existing ep34 captured sample0, stage0 and stage3 block0 trueFC2; entire captured T/P/C domain, already-inspected source cohort
equivalence: Exact equality of every source flag over C, with one fixed theta/weight identity per layer; no approximate hashing, partial match, cross-layer sharing or shortcut equality assumption
strong_baseline: All-zero source rows already omitted from rawY storage and moment arithmetic, with explicit zero bitmap/default value. Only nonzero duplicate rows provide incremental opportunity.
measures: nonzero rows versus unique nonzero full-source vectors
nonzero source contribution and direct-add opportunities
Y payload saved before and after explicit class keys, row indices and counts
storage_accounting: FP32 Y only for payload coordinate, not a frozen-FP proof. Candidate includes packed fullC class keys, per-row class codes and per-class multiplicities. Hash-table occupancy, access ports, scheduling and source verification are additional unmodeled costs.
diagnostic: Two small signed integer coefficient vectors times nonunit rational theta; exact int64 first and second moments including multiplicities. Not trained weights or frozen FP32 BN equivalence.
stop: If nonzero repetition or explicit-state savings are small/negative, do not build RTL or tune class subgroups on the same cohort.
